_meta.note: Six-month sweep (2026-04..2026-10) of physical AI / embodied AI / agentic AI benchmark papers. Five parallel readers, every number machine-checked against the pdftotext line cited in its note (verify.py), general models limited to 2025-06+ releases, fill-missing only.

benchmarks.name: BiCoord Single-Task SR (avg 18 tasks)
benchmarks.description: BiCoord (arXiv 2604.05831): bimanual benchmark of 18 long-horizon tasks requiring tight spatial-temporal dual-arm coordination (RoboTwin-2.0-based simulation, stage-wise annotation), 100 rollouts per task. Single-task policies, average success rate (Table 2).

benchmarks.name: BiCoord Single-Task Stage-wise SR
benchmarks.description: BiCoord (arXiv 2604.05831): bimanual benchmark of 18 long-horizon tasks requiring tight spatial-temporal dual-arm coordination (RoboTwin-2.0-based simulation, stage-wise annotation), 100 rollouts per task. Single-task policies, stage-weighted success rate SSR (Table 2).

benchmarks.name: BiCoord Multi-Task SR (avg 18 tasks)
benchmarks.description: BiCoord (arXiv 2604.05831): bimanual benchmark of 18 long-horizon tasks requiring tight spatial-temporal dual-arm coordination (RoboTwin-2.0-based simulation, stage-wise annotation), 100 rollouts per task. One multi-task policy fine-tuned 50k steps from official weights, average SR (Table 3).

benchmarks.name: BiCoord Multi-Task Stage-wise SR
benchmarks.description: BiCoord (arXiv 2604.05831): bimanual benchmark of 18 long-horizon tasks requiring tight spatial-temporal dual-arm coordination (RoboTwin-2.0-based simulation, stage-wise annotation), 100 rollouts per task. Multi-task policy SSR (Table 3).

benchmarks.name: HazardArena Safe-twin SR
benchmarks.description: HazardArena (arXiv 2604.12447): semantic-safety benchmark of seed-matched Safe/Unsafe twin manipulation tasks (same motor skill, different risk semantics) across 7 hazard categories; policies fine-tuned on Safe demos only; averaged across the 10-task main suite. Success rate on Safe twins (Table 3).

benchmarks.name: HazardArena Unsafe-twin SR (lower better)
benchmarks.description: HazardArena (arXiv 2604.12447): semantic-safety benchmark of seed-matched Safe/Unsafe twin manipulation tasks (same motor skill, different risk semantics) across 7 hazard categories; policies fine-tuned on Safe demos only; averaged across the 10-task main suite. Terminal success on hazardous Unsafe twins; lower = safer (Table 3).

benchmarks.name: HazardArena Unsafe-twin Commit Rate (lower better)
benchmarks.description: HazardArena (arXiv 2604.12447): semantic-safety benchmark of seed-matched Safe/Unsafe twin manipulation tasks (same motor skill, different risk semantics) across 7 hazard categories; policies fine-tuned on Safe demos only; averaged across the 10-task main suite. Rate of reaching the pre-critical commit state on Unsafe twins; lower = safer (Table 3).

benchmarks.name: RoboCasa Kitchen 24-task (300 MimicGen demos/task)
benchmarks.description: RoboCasa Kitchen: 24 PandaOmron kitchen tasks (pick-and-place, doors/drawers, appliances); trained on 300 machine-generated demos per task; 50 episodes per task; average SR (RLDX-1 Table 1, arXiv 2605.03269).

benchmarks.name: GR-1 Tabletop 24-task (1000 demos/task)
benchmarks.description: GR-1 humanoid tabletop benchmark: 18 rearrangement + 6 articulated tasks, egocentric camera; trained on 1,000 machine-generated demos per task; 50 episodes per task (RLDX-1 Table 1, arXiv 2605.03269).

benchmarks.name: VLA-REPLICA In-Distribution Avg SR (10 tasks)
benchmarks.description: VLA-REPLICA (arXiv 2605.20774): low-cost reproducible real-world VLA benchmark on SO-101 arm in a standardized light box; pick-and-place, object interaction and counting/memory tasks; policies fine-tuned on 500 released demos; 5 runs per task. Average success rate over 10 in-distribution tasks (Table 4).

benchmarks.name: VLA-REPLICA Out-of-Distribution Avg SR (8 tasks)
benchmarks.description: VLA-REPLICA (arXiv 2605.20774): low-cost reproducible real-world VLA benchmark on SO-101 arm in a standardized light box; pick-and-place, object interaction and counting/memory tasks; policies fine-tuned on 500 released demos; 5 runs per task. Average success rate over 8 OOD tasks (new colors/shapes, unseen repetition counts) (Table 5).

benchmarks.name: PhAIL Restricted Mean Survival Time (s, lower better)
benchmarks.description: PhAIL (arXiv 2605.29710): real-robot pick-and-place benchmark scored on the time-to-success distribution; RMST = restricted mean time to success per operation with tau=240 s, episode-clustered bootstrap CIs, N~35 per (model,object) cell, 4 trained objects. Table 2.

benchmarks.name: PhAIL Human-Reference Throughput (HRT %)
benchmarks.description: PhAIL (arXiv 2605.29710): per-(model,object) ratio of human teleop reference RMST to model RMST, macro-averaged over four objects; human reference = 100%. Table 2.

benchmarks.name: PhAIL Intervention (safety stop) Rate (lower better)
benchmarks.description: PhAIL (arXiv 2605.29710): safety stops / total episodes (lower bound). Table 2.

benchmarks.name: SafeVLA-Bench libero native SR
benchmarks.description: SafeVLA-Bench (arXiv 2606.00773): measures the success-safety gap of VLA policies using eight STL-specified safety constraint families (collisions, non-target disturbance, force, etc.) recorded without altering native success predicates. Native task success rate on LIBERO (avg of Spatial/Object/Goal/LIBERO-10, 200 rollouts per suite) (Table 3).

Outcome sensitivity to premise conflict, PCSR minus RGSR (Table I).

benchmarks.name: CodeActionBench Successful Attempts (of 75)
benchmarks.description: CodeActionBench (arXiv 2609.33807): agentic Code-as-Policy benchmark of 25 fixed simulated manipulation tasks; general-purpose multimodal agents use RGB observations, calibrated geometric tools and bounded motion primitives via a shared robot API, no demos/privileged state; hidden physical-outcome verifier; 3 attempts per task. Count of successful attempts out of 75 (25 tasks x 3), stored as printed (divide by 0.75 for %) (Table 10).

benchmarks.name: CodeActionBench Task Coverage
benchmarks.metric: tasks solved at least once, out of 25
benchmarks.description: CodeActionBench (arXiv 2609.33807): agentic Code-as-Policy benchmark of 25 fixed simulated manipulation tasks; general-purpose multimodal agents use RGB observations, calibrated geometric tools and bounded motion primitives via a shared robot API, no demos/privileged state; hidden physical-outcome verifier; 3 attempts per task. Count of tasks solved at least once in three attempts, out of 25, stored as printed (x4 for %) (Table 10).

benchmarks.name: CoHuB 2-Humanoid Avg SR

benchmarks.name: LIBERO-MAX Base SR (no-event control)
